music.prompt: Instrumental intro for a tech product launch film, 120 BPM. Opens with a low dark ambient synth pad and a soft ticking closed hi-hat, sparse and tense. Halfway through, a pulsing synth arpeggio enters and a filter sweep and reverse cymbal riser build steadily, peaking right at the very end. No drums before the end. no vocals, no singing.

Instrumental main theme for a modern tech product launch film, 120 BPM. Full band from the very first beat with no intro, no build-up and no fade-in: warm driving analog synth bass, crisp punchy electronic drums, a bright plucked synth hook. Confident and optimistic, steady high energy all the way to the end with no breakdown. No vocals, no singing.

Instrumental outro for a tech product launch film, 120 BPM. Calm and stripped back: soft round synth bass and gentle electric piano chords, focused and hopeful, no heavy drums. Resolves into one sustained warm final chord that rings out with a long reverb tail. no vocals, no singing.
